name: Nura (postmarketOS)
description: A Linux distribution for phones and other mobile devices, formerly called postmarketOS.
summary: Generative AI tools are forbidden: contributions fully or partly created with them are not allowed, nor is recommending them to other community members. The project cites ethical concerns and the extra burden such contributions put on maintainers.
